title: Congressional Research Service UFO study for Carter with Sheehan as special counsel

tellings.quote: he asked the uh Congressional uh Science and Technology committee to to contact the the uh Congressional research service and have them do a special uh research project for him on what all the information was that our United States government had uh about the UFO phenomena

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that in 1977, on behalf of President Jimmy Carter, the congressional Science and Technology committee asked the Congressional Research Service, the research office of Congress at the Library of Congress, to gather everything the US government knew "about the UFO phenomena". Sheehan tells Michels he worked on the project as special counsel, and he names a researcher, Marcia Smith. If true, it would mean a sitting president quietly asked for a full accounting of the government's UFO files.
